text:
maria-sales: Quick check — customer asks if we can guarantee EU-only data path for a POC (no cross-border egress). They also want BYO KMS and a pinned region for latency. Any blockers?
devon-se: Short answer: yes for POC with Dedicated or Private control plane. Need to validate subprocessor list for selected EU regions + network peers. Pricing note: reserved capacity needed for pinned throughput, otherwise best-effort.
oliver-solutions: We can do tenant pinning to eu-west-1 and disable cross-region failover. Will need a routing policy config and ops change. Also confirm if they require on-prem certs for peering.
sarah-legal: Need to run security questionnaire section on subprocessors + DPA details. BYO KMS acceptable if customer supplies key material and we can integrate via our KMS connector. Confirm whether HSM is required.
maria-sales: Customer specifically: "GDPR-controlled, no US subprocessors, EU-only chain, BYO KMS with HSM-backed keys ideal". Also asks about additional cost.
devon-se: Cost: hosting in EU Dedicated will add a region premium + potential egress adjustments. For BYO KMS + HSM, if they want HSM at our side we need enterprise add-on; if they bring their own HSM in their VPC, that's standard. Estimate: +20-30% on top of base dedicated price for strict residency handling and SLA.
ops-bot: @channel Routing policy template uploaded to ops repo: https://internal.redwood/ops/routing-policies#eu-pin
oliver-solutions: paste of sample policy:
```
{
  "routing": "region_pin",
  "preferred_region": "eu-west-1",
  "allow_failover": false,
  "subprocessor_filter": "eu_only"
}
```
maria-sales: Timeline Q — how long to provision Dedicated pool and configure pinning for POC?
devon-se: Provisioning Dedicated pool typically 5-7 business days once contract signed; pinning + BYO KMS wiring ~2-3 days of ops work. If they need cert peering and network whitelisting, add another 2-3 days.
sarah-legal: Also flag: if they insist on "no US subprocessors", ops must confirm our EU subprocessors list and any CDN/monitoring vendors used. I'll attach the latest subprocessor inventory in follow-up.
maria-sales: Ok — can someone draft a one-pager we can share with the customer summarizing: EU-only data path, BYO KMS options, provisioning timeline, and cost delta? I can attach the security questionnaire.
oliver-solutions: I’ll draft the one-pager and include the policy snippet + rough cost band. Expect a draft by EOD.
maria-sales: Awesome, thanks. tagging @sarah-legal and @devon-se for final signoff on wording.
sarah-legal: Will review after draft, add legal language around DPA and subprocessors.
ops-bot: Note: ticket created INT-5243 to track the provisioning steps and cert requests.
